template_rules.$bundle_file: Load the frozen relative agent files manifest and seal unchanged source/image bytes; verify prewritten canonical manifest/revision before dispatch.
template_rules.$response: Resolve the exact named earlier response path; no inferred or selected alternative response is allowed.
template_rules.request_ref: Reuse the exact prior request object including request_id; only listed override tests may modify it.
template_rules.expected_status: For inherited source/support refusals retain the exact public status from the inherited service schema; each specified diagnostic and state invariant is mandatory. If the listed status differs, retain failure and request reviewed correction before changing it.
template_rules.$capture: Use the exact fault/barrier capture field from that real request; never manufacture another ID.
template_rules.$loop: Use the current zero-based loop index/byte offset derived solely from exact previous returned bytes; retain each concrete materialized request and response.

scenarios.name: invalid-selected-rollback
scenarios.retained_diagnostic_source_snapshot: An immutable never-accepted candidate snapshot may be retained by inherited _snapshot before validation. It must not gain accepted-once state, an ordinary run, an artifact, or replace accepted bytes.

scenarios.name: cursor-versus-stale-edit
assertions: Retain the exact original nonempty cursor; repeat the original first-page query after reopen and require its next_cursor equals that retained token before consuming it. The continuation response may advance next_cursor.
Old cursor is valid for its original revision and query, then refused when coupled to the new revision.
Stale edit uses a new request ID, so rejection proves revision checking rather than retry identity.

scenarios.name: interrupted-artifact-publication
scenarios.fault: Wrap the real _persist_task_metadata invoked inside _commit_task. Once task.artifact contains verified bytes and db.in_transaction is true, preserve prepared artifact identity/bytes and raise one fresh sentinel subclass of BaseException. Let the transaction unwind; restore the original method; close the service, then reopen the same store. Issue no cancel.
